thread:
anya: short decision thread 1min. exec wants a reliable pilot for Optimize toolkit focused on mobile customers. need to pick tech scope and clear launch gates.
sam: can we prioritize what moves the needle fastest? my bet: adaptive batching + eval-triggering + per-route quant presets. caching is high value but larger lift.
mira: customers care about perceived latency and billing. they asked for a single-digit p50 increase at most and ~20% token saving. they can accept modest wording drift.
kevin: runtime constraints: we can implement per-route quant presets so sensitive routes (payments) stay at 16/8-bit while low-risk routes use 8/6-bit. that reduces blast radius.
lucy: ops notes: last rollout of broad quant caused a tricky tail case. must include a divergence metric and an immediate rollback leash. also support FAQ.
anya: propose MVP: 1) adaptive micro-batching with route-aware windows, 2) eval-trigger rules per-route using golden sets, 3) per-route quant presets (default conservative). skip client caching for pilot.
sam: good. acceptance criteria suggestion: - token cost drop >=20% on pilot traffic - p50 latency <= baseline + 8% - p95 <= baseline + 20% - per-route concordance >=0.975 on golden sets - <=2 SE escalations/week.
mira: i'll supply golden prompt sets and baseline labels for the two pilot customers (PulseRide, LumenPay).
kevin: for eval-triggers, recommend composite score: semantic-similarity drop + perplexity delta + length delta. threshold tuned per route. example rule: 
``
route: payments
metrics:
  sim_drop: 0.04
  ppl_ratio: 1.15
actions:
  notify: #optimize-ops
  rollback: true
```
lucy: +1 to route-level thresholds. i'll draft the runbook with triage steps, contact list, and customer messaging templates.
sam: rollout plan: feature-flag + staged canary per-customer (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with 24h holds. if eval-alert fires we auto-roll back the route and notify ops.
anya: decision: ship MVP as proposed. keep aggressive quant as an internal experiment behind a separate flag. scope-shrink plan: if timeline slips, drop per-route presets and ship batching + eval-rules first.
ci-bot: feature-flag branch merged to staging at 1768889100. CI status: green.
anya: owners: sam -> rollout & dashboards, kevin -> runtime + presets, mira -> golden prompts, lucy -> support/runbook. reconvene Thu to lock launch gate. :white_check_mark:
